name: Zhejiang Humanoid Robot Innovation Center
name_zh: 浙江人形机器人创新中心
summary:
Zhejiang Humanoid Robot Innovation Center develops complete humanoid robots and the technologies that connect high-level intelligence with motion control. Established in late 2023 by Professor Xiong Rong's team and industrial partners, the center combines research, commercialization and robotics talent development.

Its work covers full-size robot systems, stable locomotion, environmental interaction and precise manipulation. The NAVIAI portfolio and SPIRE intelligence system bring these capabilities together for industrial and commercial applications. The center also participates in robotics standards and shared technical initiatives, linking its research background with efforts to make humanoid systems useful in real operating environments.
